metadata.creator: United States. War Department
metadata.description:
Original Ordnance Dept. manual detailing the Hotchkiss gun that was an optional weapons mount for the Mark VIII tank in WWI.

The scan here has been processed with the GNU Image Manipulation Program, Imagemagick, and ScanTailor - the latter in particular was used to minimize distortion of the pages due to the binding.

A second scan of this handbook is available at the Ike Skelton Combined Arms Research Library.
